SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.id = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN c.id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "colour" c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg = 0 OR s.weight_kg IS NULL;
773:

    s."superhero_name",
    p."publisher_name"
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "publisher" p ON p."id" = s."publisher_id"

1342:

1349:

JOIN event e ON b."link_to_event" = e."event_id"

1447:

FROM "event" e
JOIN "budget" b
    ON b."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
WHERE b."remaining" > 0

JOIN "major" mj ON m."link_to_major" = mj."major_id"

1365:
WITH lowest_budget AS (
    SELECT b."budget_id"
    FROM "budget" b
    ORDER BY b."remaining" ASC NULLS FIRST
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT e."expense_description"
FROM "expense" e
JOIN lowest_budget lb ON e."link_to_budget" = lb."budget_id"
1388:
SELECT
    m."first_name",
    m."last_name",
    i."source"
FROM "income" i
JOIN "member" m ON m."member_id" = i."link_to_member"
WHERE i."amount" = (
    SELECT MAX(i2."amount")
    FROM "income" i2
)
ORDER BY m."first_name" ASC NULLS FIRST, m."last_name" ASC NULLS FIRST;
1426:

    m."last_name",
    mj."department",
    mj."college"
FROM "member" m

    ON m."link_to_major" = mj."major_id"
WHERE mj."major_name" LIKE '%Environmental Engineering%';
1456:
SELECT
    m."first_name",
    m."last_name",
    MAX(e."cost") AS max_cost
FROM "member" m
JOIN "expense" e ON e."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
GROUP BY m."member_id", m."first_name", m."last_name"
ORDER BY max_cost DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5;
1453:
WITH avg_parking AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(e."cost") / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT b."link_to_event"), 0) AS avg_cost
    FROM "expense" e
    JOIN "budget" b ON e."link_to_budget" = b."budget_id"
    WHERE b."category" = 'Parking'
)

SELECT DISTINCT ev."event_name"
FROM "event" ev
JOIN "budget" b ON b."link_to_event" = ev."event_id"
JOIN "expense" e ON e."link_to_budget" = b."budget_id"
CROSS JOIN avg_parking ap
WHERE b."category" = 'Parking'
  AND e."cost" < ap.avg_cost
ORDER BY ev."event_name" ASC NULLS FIRST;

    z."city",
    z."state"
FROM "member" m
JOIN "major" mj
    ON m."link_to_major" = mj."major_id"

WHERE e."type" NOT LIKE '%Fundraising%'

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e."event_date") = 2019 THEN b."spent" ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e."event_date") = 2020 THEN b."spent" ELSE 0 END) AS "difference"
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e."event_date") IN (2019, 2020);

JOIN "member" m ON e."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
WHERE m."first_name" LIKE 'Elijah'
  AND m."last_name" LIKE 'Allen'

1359:
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN e."event_name" LIKE '%Yearly Kickoff%' THEN b."amount" ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC
    /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN e."event_name" LIKE '%October Meeting%' THEN b."amount" ELSE 0 END), 0)::NUMERIC
    AS ratio
FROM "budget" b
JOIN "event" e ON b."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
WHERE b."category" = 'Advertisement'
  AND (e."event_name" LIKE '%Yearly Kickoff%' OR e."event_name" LIKE '%October Meeting%')

1437:

    m."last_name",
    a."link_to_event"
FROM "expense" e
JOIN "member" m
    ON m."member_id" = e."link_to_member"
JOIN "attendance" a
    ON a."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
WHERE e."approved" = 'true'
  AND e."expense_date"::date BETWEEN DATE '2019-01-10' AND DATE '2019-11-19'

1448:
SELECT DISTINCT
    e."event_name",
    e."event_date"
FROM "event" e
JOIN "budget" b ON b."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
JOIN "expense" ex ON ex."link_to_budget" = b."budget_id"
WHERE ex."expense_description" LIKE '%Pizza%'
  AND ex."cost" > 50
  AND ex."cost" < 100
ORDER BY e."event_date" ASC NULLS FIRST;
1451:
SELECT
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    MAX(e.cost) AS max_cost
FROM expense e
JOIN member m
    ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
JOIN budget b
    ON b.budget_id = e.link_to_budget
WHERE e.link_to_member IN (
    
    SELECT e2.link_to_member
    FROM expense e2
    JOIN budget b2
        ON b2.budget_id = e2.link_to_budget
    GROUP BY e2.link_to_member
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b2.link_to_event) > 1
)
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
ORDER BY max_cost DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;
